detailed_description: The Treemap Chart Generator helps you build a browser-side treemap from manually edited hierarchical nodes. Start with the default data or load the sample dataset, then edit node names and values, add child nodes, remove nodes, and watch the ECharts preview update. The chart settings include a title field, color theme selector, leaf depth slider, label toggle, and breadcrumb toggle. When the chart is ready, download it as PNG or SVG from the toolbar.
usage_steps: Load the sample data or edit the default nodes directly in the data editor.
Change node names and values, then use the plus button to add child nodes when you need hierarchy.
Set the chart title, choose a color theme, adjust leaf depth, and toggle labels or breadcrumbs.
Review the live treemap preview on the right side of the tool.
Download the finished chart as PNG or SVG.
usage_examples: Sketch a category breakdown by entering each category name and value.
Create a simple budget or portfolio overview with parent categories and child line items.
Build a product mix visualization from manually entered product groups.
Export a PNG or SVG treemap for a report, slide, or internal note.
